definitions.explanation: A shop charging by the hour for a booth with an internet-connected computer, drinks, and usually manga and video content. In Japan these overlap almost completely with manga cafes, and many are open around the clock.

examples.japanese: ネットカフェ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}した→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I printed the documents at an internet cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧ネットカフェ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Around here there are internet cafes open even in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、ネットカフェ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝泊|ねと}まり⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that quite a few people with nowhere to live sleep at internet cafes.

notes:
From English "net cafe"; the fuller インターネットカフェ appears in formal writing. The compound ネットカフェ{難民|なんみん} ("internet cafe refugees") is a well-known term for people who live in such booths for lack of housing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ネットカフェ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to stop by an internet cafe
- ネットカフェ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夜|よ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧: to spend the night at an internet cafe
- ネットカフェ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会員|かいいん}{証|しょう}→会員証：22898_kaiinshou⟧: an internet cafe membership card

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}→漫画喫茶：30265_mangakissa⟧: manga cafe — the same kind of shop, named for its manga library instead
- ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: cafe — an ordinary coffee shop, with no per-hour booth rental
